desc: Skill-chip port that lets the user load Activesofts, Knowsofts, and Linguasofts directly into the brain.
effect: Required for using skillsofts (Active/Know/Lingua).
Combine with a Datajack to upload from a deck.

desc: Standard neural port that connects the brain to cyberdecks, vehicles, and other electronic gear.
effect: Required for jacking into a cyberdeck or rigging a vehicle.
Provides standard datajack I/O to most headware and bodyware.

desc: Internal full-band radio transceiver with sub-vocal mic, allowing covert two-way communication.
effect: Cyber-equivalent of a portable radio.
Includes sub-vocal mic so the user can speak silently.

desc: Receive-only internal radio for monitoring broadcasts without transmitting.
effect: Receives radio signals but cannot transmit.
Cheaper, lower-essence alternative to the full Radio.

desc: Internal cellular handset with sub-vocal mic that connects to the public phone net.
effect: Place and receive phone calls without external hardware.
Speak silently via sub-vocalization.

desc: Full prosthetic replacement of the natural ear, providing the platform for further auditory cyberware.
effect: Required base for ear modifications.
Costs 0.2 less Essence if installed during replacement of a lost ear.

desc: Add-on slot fitted to an existing cyber ear that hosts a single auditory enhancement.
effect: Allows one ear-enhancement to be added without full replacement.
Each enhancement requires its own modification slot.

desc: Purely cosmetic styling for a cyber ear, from human-shaped to pointed or alien forms.
effect: No mechanical effect.
Allows custom appearance of cyber ears.

desc: Automatic limiter that clamps the ear when exposed to dangerously loud sounds.
effect: Protects against flash-bangs and similar sonic attacks.
Reduces deafening damage from loud noises.

desc: Extends hearing into ultrasonic frequencies above the normal human range.
effect: Detects high-frequency sounds (dog whistles, ultrasonic motion alarms).
Cannot be normally heard by unmodified people.

desc: Extends hearing into subsonic frequencies below the normal human range.
effect: Detects infrasound, distant explosions, and seismic noise.
Cannot be normally heard by unmodified people.

desc: Built-in audio recorder that captures everything the user hears for later playback.
effect: Records sound to internal storage.
Output can be routed through a cyberear, datajack, or external speaker.

desc: Full prosthetic eye providing 20/20 vision and the base for additional optical cyberware.
effect: Required base for most eye enhancements.
Costs 0.1 less Essence if installed when replacing a lost eye.

desc: Built-in stills/video camera that records what the eye sees for later download or transmission.
effect: Stores or transmits digital images of what the user sees.
Outputs via datajack or cyberdeck.

desc: Cosmetic styling for cyber eyes, from natural color to mirrorshade or corporate-logo finishes.
effect: No mechanical effect.
Customizes the visible appearance of cyber eyes.

desc: Auto-darkening optics that protect the user from bright flashes and glare attacks.
effect: Eliminates target-number penalties from glare and flash.
Defends against flash-pak attacks.

desc: Light-amplifying optics that let the user see normally in low-light environments.
effect: Negates target-number modifiers for low light.
Useless in pitch darkness.

desc: Illegal cosmetic surgery that recreates another person's retinal pattern for defeating retinal scanners.
effect: Fools retinal-scan ID systems.
Possession is a criminal offense.

desc: Heat-imaging optics that let the user see infrared signatures of warm objects.
effect: See heat sources through fog, smoke, and darkness.
Detects recent body-heat trails.

desc: Brain-implanted explosive that detonates on command or under preset triggers — usually used for coercion.
effect: Lethal explosive in 1m radius.
Triggers via signal or set conditions; usually booby-trapped.

desc: Heads-up display projected onto the retina or cyber eye, used to view text, video, and smartgun data.
effect: Required to read smartgun data and other HUD feeds.
Displays output from headware and external sources.

desc: Skillsoft chip running a full (General) Active skill.
effect: Runs a General Active skill; requires a Softlink AND Skillwires to use.
Cost = General-skill Mp x 100 per Rating (no Essence -- it is software).

desc: Skillsoft chip running an Active skill Concentration.
effect: Runs an Active skill Concentration; requires a Softlink AND Skillwires to use.
Cost = Concentration Mp x 100 per Rating (no Essence).

desc: Skillsoft chip running an Active skill Specialization.
effect: Runs an Active skill Specialization; requires a Softlink AND Skillwires to use.
Cost = Specialization Mp x 100 per Rating (no Essence).

desc: Read-only data chip containing books, manuals, maps, or other reference material.
effect: Read through a Datasoft Link or cyberdeck.
No mechanical skill bonus — pure information.

desc: Skillsoft chip running a full (General) Knowledge skill.
effect: Runs a General Knowledge skill; requires a Softlink to use.
Cannot default Active skill tests.
Cost = General Mp x 150 per Rating (no Essence).

desc: Skillsoft chip running a Knowledge skill Concentration.
effect: Runs a Knowledge skill Concentration; requires a Softlink to use.
Cost = Concentration Mp x 150 per Rating (no Essence).

desc: Skillsoft chip running a Knowledge skill Specialization.
effect: Runs a Knowledge skill Specialization; requires a Softlink to use.
Cost = Specialization Mp x 150 per Rating (no Essence).

kw: skillsoft skillwire skillwires skill language linguasoft
desc: Skillsoft chip that grants fluency in a single language while loaded.
effect: Provides a Language skill at the chosen Rating; requires a Softlink to use.
One language per chip.
Cost = Language Mp x 50 per Rating (no Essence).

desc: Tiny storage cavity replacing the last joint of a finger, used to conceal small items.
effect: Holds a single very small object.
Useful for smuggling chips or hidden tools.

options.desc: Concealed datajack in the fingertip compartment; functions as a standard datajack.
Concealed lock-picking tools; grants Lockpicking Skill Rating 3 for picking attempts (noted on the character sheet -- no matching skill exists in this catalog).
Retractable needle holding a single dose of an injectable compound; cannot pierce Hardened Armor.

desc: Carbide blades implanted under the fingernails, deployed as natural claw weapons.
effect: Provides Unarmed melee damage as cyber-claws.
Compatible with synthetic skin/nails.

desc: Retractable upgrade to Hand Razors that hide the blades inside the finger when not in use.
effect: Concealable melee blades that extend on demand.
Harder to spot than fixed Hand Razors.

desc: Surgical replacement of major muscle groups with synthetic fiber, boosting raw physical performance.
effect: Adds Rating to both Strength and Quickness.
Maximum Rating 4.

desc: Retractable forearm spur that extends from the back of the hand as a built-in melee weapon.
effect: Retractable Str+2 melee blade.
Easier to conceal than fixed Spurs.

desc: Fixed cyber-spur protruding from the forearm, used as an always-ready melee weapon.
effect: Provides Str+2 melee damage code.
Always extended — obvious.

desc: Cyber-link that interfaces a smartgun directly with the user's eye and trigger control.
effect: Reduces target number on smartgun-equipped weapons by 2.
Requires a Display Link to function.

desc: Cyber-larynx that lets the user shift pitch and timbre of their voice across a wide range.
effect: Allows controlled changes in voice pitch, gender, and tone.

options.desc: Raises voice volume up to about 110 dB (turns the voice into a loudspeaker).
Simultaneous multi-tonal output; vocal harmonies and audible impressions of other voices.
Records audio internally and replays it as speech; output also routes through datajack.
Loads a full second voice pattern to mimic a specific recorded person almost perfectly (via datajack).

desc: Subdermal plates of plastic and metal that armor the skin under a layer of synthetic flesh. Higher ratings use heavier plating.
effect: +1 Body per Rating for resisting damage (armor already counted in the Armor total).
R3: heavy, blatantly obvious modification.
Incompatible with Dermal Sheath R3 or Orthoskin R3+.

desc: Implanted respiratory filter that traps airborne toxins and particulates before they reach the lungs.
effect: Opposes inhaled toxins with the unit's Rating.
0.1 Essence and 15,000¥ per level; Rating cap 10.

desc: In-line bloodstream filter that strips toxins and pathogens from blood as it circulates.
effect: Opposes blood-borne toxins with the unit's Rating.
0.2 Essence and 10,000¥ per level; Rating cap 10.
Specialized form: anti-alcohol filter exists.

desc: Gut-implanted filter array that neutralizes ingested poisons and contaminated food.
effect: Opposes ingested toxins with the unit's Rating.
0.1 Essence and 10,000¥ per level; Rating cap 10.
Limited filter capacity per period.

desc: Basic prosthetic arm or leg that restores normal function after the loss of a natural limb.
effect: Functions as a normal limb.
No special abilities or upgrade slots.

desc: Full cybernetic arm or leg that can host built-in weapons, devices, and physical enhancements.
effect: Replacement limb with internal modification slots.
Adds dramatic obvious cyberware to the user.

options.desc: Synthetic skin overlay disguising the limb as natural; adds +3 to target numbers for visual Perception detection, +10% to the limb's cost.

desc: Strength upgrade module fitted into a cyber limb to push lifting and striking power beyond human norms.
effect: Adds Rating to the limb's Strength (150,000¥ per point, no Essence).
Add-on to a cyber arm only.
Caps at +3 above natural; higher points need Cyberlimb reinforcement (Cybertechnology).

desc: Internal smartgun link wired through a cyber arm for a concealed weapons interface.
effect: Built-in smartlink for weapons mounted in the limb.
Counts as a normal smartlink (-2 TN).

desc: Slot for an additional internal device (gun, tool, or gadget) hidden inside a cyber limb.
effect: Houses an additional piece of cyberware inside a limb.
Cost is four times the standard price of the device.

desc: Neural rig that connects a rigger directly to vehicles, drones, and other remote systems. Higher ratings deepen the neural bandwidth for full sensory immersion.
effect: Allows rigging of vehicles via datajack.
+1D6 Initiative per Rating when jacked in.
+2 Reaction per Rating while rigging (Control Pool = rigging Reaction).
Avail/Index by Rating: R1 6/48 hrs, Index 1 — R2 8/48 hrs, Index 1.25 — R3 12/20 days, Index 1.5.

desc: Synthetic nerve and muscle wiring that accelerates reaction time well beyond natural limits. Higher ratings add heavier reflex-booster packages.
effect: +2 Reaction per Rating.
+1D6 Initiative per Rating.
Avail by Rating: R1/R2 4/8 days — R3 8/14 days.

desc: Internal commlink that lets the user monitor two channels of voice or radio simultaneously.
effect: Manages two radio/telephone channels at once.
Selectively mutes channels and displays channel status.

desc: Mid-grade commlink that handles four channels of radio or telephone traffic at once.
effect: Monitors up to four channels simultaneously.
Routes, screens, and displays channel data.

desc: Heavy-duty commlink supporting eight simultaneous channels for sophisticated operators.
effect: Manages eight channels at once.
Allows selective lock-out and HUD display.

desc: Top-end commlink that simultaneously monitors and manages ten channels of communication.
effect: Tracks up to ten radio or phone channels.
Used by command staff and net runners.

desc: Headware encryption module that scrambles transmissions on a paired commlink, radio, or phone.
effect: Encrypts and decrypts cyber-comm traffic.
Receiver needs equal-or-better Crypto Circuit to listen in.

desc: Mid-grade Crypto Circuit module for sensitive corporate and security traffic.
effect: Higher-rated encryption layer.
External equipment runs at half cost.

desc: Near-military-grade Crypto Circuit used for high-value coded channels.
effect: Strong sequenced-code encryption.
Often combined with Scramble Breaker for code-cracking.

desc: Top-tier military-spec encryption hardware available only on the black market.
effect: Maximum-grade cyber-encryption.
Restricted to military, government, and corp security.

desc: Auditory boost that increases sensitivity, letting the user hear as if standing roughly ten times closer.
effect: Dramatically increases hearing range.
Damper system strongly recommended to prevent overload.

desc: Implanted version of the Voice Mask that disguises the user's vocal pattern from voice scanners.
effect: Adds 2D6+2 to opposed voice-recognition tests.
Improved masking over external mask units.

desc: Cyber-sight accessory that reports the precise distance to whatever the user is looking at or aiming at.
effect: Displays range to target via Display Link.
Useful with smartguns and indirect-fire weapons.

desc: Headware decryption module that tries to crack scrambled signals being received by paired comm gear.
effect: Attempts to break enemy encryption.
Loses only 0.1 Essence when packaged with paired comm gear.

desc: Mid-tier Scramble Breaker for cracking corporate-grade encrypted traffic.
effect: Stronger decryption versus tougher codes.
External equipment runs at half cost.

desc: Maximum-rated Scramble Breaker for cracking even military encryption.
effect: Top-end cyber-decryption.
Matches Data Codebreaker / Datalink Encryption System hardware.

desc: Auditory filter that selectively suppresses unwanted background noise without dampening other sounds.
effect: Rating dice for an Unresisted Test to filter out chosen noise.
Compatible with other ear cyberware.

desc: Implanted simsense rig that records full-sensory impressions for later playback.
effect: Records sight, sound, smell, taste, touch, and emotions.
Stores roughly 10Mp per 10 seconds of simsense.

desc: Add-on broadcaster that transmits the Sense Link's simsense feed in real time.
effect: Streams live simsense from a Sense Link.
Requires a cyberdeck or simsense player on the receiving end.

desc: Cyber receiver that lets the user play back a Sense Link feed directly inside their own senses.
effect: Receives and replays simsense transmissions.
Concealability 3.

desc: External transmitter accessory that broadcasts a Sense Link recording from outside the body.
effect: Non-cybernetic Sense Link transmitter.
Concealability 4.

desc: External pocket recorder that captures a Sense Link feed; memory chips sold separately.
effect: Stores simsense feed on portable media.
Memory not included in base price.

desc: Cyber-eye accessory that records or transmits high-fidelity live video of what the user sees.
effect: Records 1 minute of low-resolution video per 6Mp.
Can transmit live or store to memory.

desc: Built-in transmitter that streams the Video Link's footage out in real time.
effect: Broadcasts live video feed from Video Link.
Concealability 9.

desc: External pocket transmitter accessory for streaming Video Link footage.
effect: Transmits Video Link signal externally.
Concealability 7.

desc: External recorder unit that captures Video Link footage on separately-bought memory.
effect: Stores Video Link footage on external media.
Memory sold separately.

desc: Optical zoom lens system installed in a cyber eye, giving the cleanest magnified image possible. Higher ratings add stronger zoom stages.
effect: Provides telescopic zoom equal to Rating.
Pure optical image with no electronic grain.
Avail by Rating: R1/R2 4/48 hrs — R3 5/48 hrs.

desc: Light-sensitive electronic zoom system that magnifies the image inside a cyber eye. Higher ratings add stronger zoom stages.
effect: Provides electronic zoom equal to Rating.
Concealability 9 — invisible in any eye type.
Avail by Rating: R1/R2 5/48 hrs — R3 8/48 hrs.

desc: Hold-Out pistol built into a cyber arm, firing through a port in the palm.
effect: Ammo 12 (Internal); damage 4L(SA); weight 0.3.
Concealability 12.

desc: Light pistol built into a cyber arm with a hidden palm-port barrel.
effect: Ammo 10 (Internal); damage 6L(SA); weight 0.75.
Concealability 10.

desc: Machine pistol concealed inside a cyber limb, firing through the palm.
effect: Ammo 10 (Internal); damage 6L (BF); weight 0.8.
External ammo port available for reloads.

desc: Sub-machine gun mounted in a cyber arm, drawing from an external ammo clip.
effect: Ammo 8 (Internal); damage 6M(FA); weight 1.25.
Reload via external port.

desc: Heavy pistol concealed inside a cyber arm for serious stopping power.
effect: Ammo 6 (Internal); damage 9M(SA); weight 2.0.
Always visible when fired in full daylight.

desc: Cyber-limb shotgun for close-range encounters, firing through the palm port.
effect: Ammo 4 (Internal); damage 8S(SA); weight 2.
Loud, obvious discharge.

desc: One-time electro-chemical treatment that boosts natural reaction speed without full cyber reflexes. Higher ratings add stronger neural enhancement.
effect: Reaction by Rating: R1 +0, R2 +1, R3 +2.
Initiative by Rating: R1 +1D6, R2 +1D6, R3 +2D6.
Blocks Wired Reflexes and Vehicle Control Rig (mutually exclusive).

desc: Compression carbide blade replacements for existing Hand Razors, fitting all current cyber-razor units.
effect: Damage code (Str + 2).
Upgrade only — requires existing Hand Razors; 20-minute swap.

desc: Throat-mounted mic that picks up faint subvocalized speech for silent comms.
effect: Allows nearly silent vocal communication.
Requires datajack to link with internal systems.
Easier to detect than internal version (+4 Perception modifier).

desc: Implanted throat mic that captures unvoiced speech with greater concealment.
effect: Allows silent vocal communication.
Requires implanted datajack to link to other gear.
Concealed inside the throat for stealth.

desc: Tiny bone-conduction speaker behind the ear, audible only to the wearer.
effect: Delivers incoming audio inaudible to bystanders.
Cannot be overheard by nearby characters.

desc: Implanted short-range radio that bundles transmitter and receiver with encryption.
effect: Provides hidden two-way radio with multi-channel scanning.
Includes burst and compression options.
Pairs with internal mic and speaker for invisible telephony.

desc: Tiny readout in the corner of the cyber eye showing time, date and a stopwatch.
effect: Constantly displays time and date.
Includes stopwatch and countdown timer accurate to fractions of a second.

desc: Sliding shutters that protect cyber eyes from glare, particles and impacts.
effect: Provides Body+5 against eye-targeted impact and particles.
Acts as one-way transparent armor.
Adds 20% to cyber eye cost when installed.

desc: Datajack hidden behind the eye that opens with light pressure for discreet jacking.
effect: Functions identically to a standard datajack.
Conceals the jack port behind the cyber eye.
Eye must be plugged into to operate.

desc: Cyber-eye-mounted laser that reads data jacks by line of sight.
effect: Reads any datajack-equipped target the user can see.
Avoids the need to physically connect.
Requires a separate Emitter accessory to transmit.

desc: Companion laser emitter that lets the scanning datajack transmit data out.
effect: Required for two-way optical jacking.
Weight 0.25 kg, conceals at rating 10.

desc: Low-fan light projector built into the cyber eye for hands-free illumination.
effect: Throws a directed beam aligned with the user's gaze.
Polarization compensates so the user isn't blinded.

desc: Upgrade producing a brilliant flash that can blind or stun nearby targets.
effect: Two intensities including a flash-pak blinder.
Higher setting can stun a target in front of the user.
Recharges between uses.

desc: Disposable single-use flash module for the BrightLight system.
effect: Burns out one extreme flash equivalent to a regular flash-pak.
Must be physically replaced after use.

desc: Eye-mounted hold-out launcher firing one half-range narcoject dart per reload.
effect: Fires narcoject/toxin rounds; one shot then reloads ten Combat Turns.
Combined with smartlink for free targeting (+2 modifier).
Holds one round; ammo costs triple standard.

desc: Eye-mounted single-shot hold-out pistol with reduced damage and range.
effect: One round (-1 damage, -1 recoil mod); ten Combat Turns to reload.
Optional Quickness Test reduces reload time.
Cannot exceed Body in orbital sockets.

desc: Eye-bound laser sight that auto-paints a target for laser designators.
effect: Auto-tracks the target the user is looking at.
Requires an external laser designator system to use.
Maximum range 1000 m.

desc: Cyber-eye laser usable as a tool or short-range weapon for cutting and burning.
effect: Damage Code 4L beyond one meter; +1 modifier for larger targets.
Cannot pierce materials with Barrier Rating greater than 8.
Special skill or Combat Pool test required to use.

desc: Implanted designator that paints targets for laser-guided weapons up to 4 km.
effect: Range up to 4000 meters.
Allows external weapons to lock onto designated target.
Often paired with laser tracker for hands-free designation.

desc: Cyber-audio enhancement that pinpoints the direction and distance of sounds.
effect: Reduces target numbers by 2 on hearing-based Perception Tests involving location.
Useful for tracking footsteps or gunfire.

desc: Inner-ear gyroscope that vastly improves balance for athletic stunts.
effect: Reduces target numbers by 2 on Athletics tests involving balance.
Applies a -2 modifier to opposed Knockdown rolls.

desc: Hidden mouth-mounted launcher firing narcoject darts via pneumatic puff.
effect: Holds three rounds; reload takes one minute per dart.
Ammo costs triple standard.
Requires Special Skill or Quickness for Ranged Combat Test.

desc: Single-shot pistol concealed in the mouth, miniaturized to a hold-out caliber.
effect: Holds four rounds; reload one minute per round.
Ammo costs triple standard.
Special Skill or Quickness Test to fire accurately.

desc: Retractable cyber-tongue weapon extending from the mouth as a melee strike.
effect: Melee weapon attack using Special Skill or Quickness.
Tongue extends and retracts as a free action.

desc: Extending tongue-whip reaching up to a meter for ranged melee strikes.
effect: Range one meter, Damage 6M.
Uses Special Skill or Quickness for Ranged Combat Test.

desc: Hollow false tooth that releases contents when bitten hard.
effect: Activates by biting; contents effect immediate.
Willpower (4) test to avoid accidental triggering.
If contents are lethal, breakage can kill the user.

desc: Hollow tooth that opens like a small drawer to stash micro-items.
effect: Holds tiny items such as microchips or microbeacons.
Contents released manually rather than by biting.
Recovering a swallowed tooth requires Complex Actions and a Quickness (4) test.

desc: Tiny cranial micro-bomb that detonates as a small but lethal blast inside the skull.
effect: Kills the wearer outright on detonation.
Triggered by remote, sound-recognition or anti-tamper.
Can cause permanent neurological side effects.

desc: Mid-power cranial bomb that not only kills but obliterates the brain and skull.
effect: Kills wearer and destroys identifying tissue.
Power 8 Damage Level M blast effect.
Often used to thwart forensic identification.

desc: Heavy cranial bomb that detonates as a full blast capable of leveling a room.
effect: Power 10 Damage Level M blast in a radius beyond the wearer.
Designed as an assassination device, not just executioner.
Reduces blast effects at -1 per meter.

desc: Cybernetic skin replacement that adds armor without rigid plating. Higher ratings replace more of the natural skin.
effect: +1 Ballistic and Impact armor per Rating, flexible coverage.
+1 Body per Rating for damage-resistance tests only (armor already counted in the Armor total).
Compatible with cyberlimbs.
R3: incompatible with Dermal Plating.

options.desc: Reactive pigments that shift to match surroundings; +20% concealment when active. Costs +50% of the sheath's price (shown here at the Rating 1 rate).
Lets the user actively control sheath coloration patterns on demand.

desc: Quickness upgrade module fitted into a cyber leg to push reflex speed beyond human norms.
effect: Adds Rating to the limb's Quickness (90,000¥ per point, no Essence).
Add-on to a cyber leg only.
Caps at +3 above natural; higher points need Cyberlimb reinforcement (Cybertechnology).

desc: Switchable electromagnets in cyberlimb hands, knees and feet for gripping ferrous surfaces.
effect: Lets the limb hold up to 25 kg per system.
Multiple systems stack on different limbs.
Magnets can erase nearby light optical chips.

desc: Integrated gyromount inside a cyberarm providing recoil compensation.
effect: Treats as standard gyromount, 3 points Recoil Reduction.
Hides the gyromount inside the limb.
Works with any weapon mountable to it.

desc: Hydraulic anchor that drives a spike down through the foot into the ground.
effect: Damage Code 8M Stun as a weapon attack.
Provides anchor point negating recoil for weapons firing.
Cannot penetrate Barrier Rating greater than 8.

desc: Cyberlimb-mounted nav system tracking exact location and orientation.
effect: Reports current direction, slope and position in three dimensions.
Can be linked with maps for hands-free orienteering.

desc: Retractable cyber-blade improvement on the basic hand blade design.
effect: Retracts into the limb when not in use.
Functions identically to hand blade for damage.
Concealment is much better than fixed hand blades.

desc: Cyberhand palm electrodes delivering a high-voltage stunning shock on contact.
effect: 8S Damage Code from charged hand.
Recharges between uses; one strike per recharge.
Range is melee only.

desc: Built-in Ares Squirt-class taser firing wired electrode darts from the cyberarm.
effect: Functions as ranged taser; 10 charges before reload; 8S Damage Code.
Hidden inside the cyberlimb.
Same range as standard cyber taser.

desc: Cyberlimb chemical squirt gun firing DMSO and up to 20 shots of payload.
effect: Holds 10 shots chemical/biological agent.
Delivers payload to porous armor and Kevlar.
Use Ranged Combat to hit; rigid armor reduces effect.

desc: Full torso replacement with cybernetic framework housing organs and accessories.
effect: Replaces natural torso with cyber framework.
Adds +1 to the Body attribute.
Body plating can be applied to it.

desc: Cybernetic skull replacement providing protection and mounting points.
effect: Adds +1 to the Body attribute.
Mounts for cyber-eye and cyber-ear extensions.

desc: Soft cyber-armor plates added to cybertorso, cyberskull or cyberlimbs.
effect: +1 Ballistic and Impact per level.
Stackable; cumulative with any worn armor.
Available only on cybertorso, cyberskull or cyberlimb.

desc: Heavy ceramic/polymer hardened armor plating on cyber body parts.
effect: +1 Ballistic and Impact per level, treated as Hardened Armor.
Only goes on cybertorso, cyberskull or cyberlimbs.
Cumulative armor with other layers.

desc: Compatible add-on for wired reflexes that further boosts Reaction.
effect: +1 Reaction per point up to a maximum of +6.
Compatible with all reaction/initiative boosters except move-by-wire.
Stackable with wired reflexes and adrenal pump.

desc: Switch upgrade that lets a user manually deactivate wired reflexes.
effect: Activate or deactivate wired reflexes with a Simple Action.
Pairs with existing wired reflex installation.
Reduces accidental triggering issues.

desc: Reflex-control system replacing nervous system signals for ultra-fast reactions. Higher ratings give more Initiative dice.
effect: +1 Quickness, +2 Reaction, +1D6 Initiative per Rating.
+1 die per Rating for Athletics and Stealth tests.
Not compatible with any other Reaction/Initiative cyberware or bioware.
Avail/Index by Rating: R1 8/10 days, Index 2.5 — R2 12/20 days, Index 3 — R3 18/30 days, Index 3 — R4 20/45 days, Index 3.5.

desc: External cyber mounting attached to forearm or shoulder for weapons or sensors.
effect: Attach/detach a weapon with a Complex Action.
Triple ammo cost for external feed.
Holds light to heavy pistols, light machine guns or sensors.

desc: Motorized eye-tracked weapon mount that aims based on the user's gaze.
effect: Auto-tracks the target the user looks at.
Triple ammo cost.
Adds 3 points Recoil Reduction; uses Eye Laser as sight.

desc: Cybered third arm extending over the shoulder for weapon use or carrying.
effect: Hard mount with 360-degree fire arc.
Holds full SMG, light pistol or sub-machine guns.
Adds 3 points Recoil Reduction; uses laser sight.

desc: Datajack equivalent that connects via wireless induction pad on the skin.
effect: Performs identically to a standard datajack.
Uses induction connector instead of wire.
Slightly higher Availability/Street Index than the standard jack.

desc: Subdermal air reservoir holding about twenty minutes of breathable supply.
effect: Twenty minutes of air with refilling in five minutes.
Vents if necessary to avoid dangerous pressure.
Helps in toxic environments.

desc: Headware expert system that boosts mental skills and runs skillsofts as a softlink.
effect: L1: 0.5 Essence / 15,000¥ — +1 Intelligence.
L2: 0.75 Essence / 40,000¥ — +1 Intelligence, +1 Task Pool.
L3: 1.5 Essence / 75,000¥ — +2 Intelligence, +2 Task Pool.
L4: 1.75 Essence / 115,000¥ — +2 Intelligence, +3 Task Pool.
Can hold and run skillsofts / datasofts (acts as a softlink). No bonus to magical skills.

desc: A dedicated math small-processing unit that accelerates calculation-heavy mental tasks.
effect: Adds half its Rating (round down) to Technical, Technical B/R, and Sciences skills.
Adds half its Rating (round down) to the Hacking Pool.

desc: Combat-data headware that improves accuracy and grants bonus combat dice.
effect: Ratings 3-4 exist but are CLASSIFIED (GM discretion) with stricter legality.
Lowers ranged TN by 1 (melee 1 per 2 levels); +1 Combat Pool die per level.
Civilian possession largely illegal.

desc: Implanted sensor that identifies chemical substances from a sample.
effect: 0.2 Essence and 2,500¥ per level (Rating cap 6).
Higher Rating = identify more complex / trace compounds.

desc: Cyber sensor that detects and identifies airborne gases.
effect: Detects and names gases in the surrounding air.
Useful for spotting toxins, knockout gas, and leaks.

desc: Nasal receptors that sharpen smell (and taste) for Perception Tests.
effect: 0.1 Essence and 1,000¥ per level (Rating cap 6).
+1 die to smell Perception per level; +1 die to taste per 3 levels.
Can be switched off to avoid overload.

desc: Bones laced with a lattice of reinforcing plastics and metals to raise their density and tensile strength.
effect: Rating is the lacing material: 1 = Plastic, 2 = Aluminum, 3 = Titanium.
L1 Plastic: 0.5 Essence / 7,500¥ — +1 Body; Unarmed Blow does (Str+1)M.
